<Subject 1> is 悟空 (S1), the young monkey-king male singer in <Picture 1> (SC1): golden-brown facial fur, sharp golden eyes, a gold dragon-pattern crown over black hair, a golden flame mark on the forehead, gold-red brocade stage armor with cloud-and-dragon embroidery, bronze chainmail shoulder plates, dark red collar, a deep red cloud-pattern cape, holding a gold dragon-carved vintage microphone.
<Picture 1> (SC1) is the rendered plate for "悟空歌手角色卡(东方奇幻·九天云海)": front-facing half-body portrait of 悟空 over rolling golden clouds, warm gold key light and cool blue rim light, distant celestial-palace silhouette.
<Picture 2> (SC2) is the rendered plate for "悟空主舞台演唱(东方奇幻·悬浮仙山)": the floating mountain arena, a rotating golden lotus-array stage, a gilded dragon-coiled pillar, nine-heaven palace silhouette, sea of star-fire glow sticks.
<Picture 3> (SC5) is the rendered plate for "悟空口型参考(东方奇幻·正面特写)": front-facing close-up of 悟空 singing with mouth wide open on a high note.
<Audio 1> is the warm gravelly male vocal of <Subject 1> (S1), the sung source of this cut; this unit reuses the A1 slice covering 00:32:560–00:37:680.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] The target video is a photoreal cinematic music-variety look in a wide 16:9 eastern-fantasy frame: warm gold divine light against cool blue-purple cloud-sea, dramatic key light, layered mist and floating golden particles, a full horizontal stage composition that lets the arena, the mentor panel and the audience occupy the frame together. 演唱4, 段④ 演唱主体, one continuous push-in that ends on a stable terminal frame. 悟空 (S1), the monkey-king singer with golden-brown fur, a dragon-pattern crown and a golden flame mark, in the gold-red brocade armor with a deep red cloud cape, stands centered on the golden lotus-array stage of the floating mountain arena from <Picture 2>, facing the lens in a chest-up medium close-up, the gold dragon-carved vintage microphone raised to his lips. He sings <d>[Chinese] 曾经与你共有的梦 今后要向谁诉说,</d> with the mouth clearly opening and closing on each syllable, following <Audio 1>; eyes look into the distant cloud-sea with a nostalgic yet defiant gaze, the cape drifting in the divine wind, the camera performing one slow push-in (small amplitude, slow speed) that ends on a stable terminal frame with the singing face still centered.

overall_soundscape:
Layered cloud-sea ambience with a low-frequency divine hum, distant roar of the star-fire audience, and a slight microphone feedback ring; the singing line itself follows <Audio 1>.

non_diegetic_music:
